newsitem.title: USA: GeoAsia says to buy Orion Technologies Inc.
newsitem.headline: GeoAsia says to buy Orion Technologies Inc.

text.p: GeoAsia Enterprises Ltd said on Monday that it had signed an agreement and merger plan with Orion Technologies Inc, a privately held company in Richmond, British Columbia.
GeoAsia announced its intent to merge with Orion Technologies in February.
The plan is subject to shareholder approval, GeoAsia said in a statement, adding that the merger was expected to take effect in early June. It said it would disclose details at that time.

Orion is currently building and will soon operate A-Net, an intranet owned by the Association of Development Financing Institutions in Asia and the Pacific to provide electronic data and financial services.
